<thought>We need to find the template used in make_7_lvl2-template_search-2. The description indicates a Doebner Modification, which forms a C=C bond and breaks C-C and C-O bonds. We'll search the template catalog for templates that form a C=C functional group when applied to the target product molecule. The target product SMILES appears to be the large aromatic sulfonamide with a C=C and amide: "Cc1ccc(NS(=O)(=O)c2ccc(/C=C/C(=O)Nc3ccccc3N)cc2)cc1". We'll call search_template_catalog_by_criteria with this SMILES and functional_groups_formed ["C=C"].</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
